what_is_working: reliability.json is the strongest thing in the set: 174 events on each side, duplicates 0, same_order_both_sides true, client holding seq 1..173 gapless and monotonic after a forced gap, 26 events queued offline and all delivered on reconnect, and a kill mid-send that the host received exactly once with no duplicate on retry.
Draft survival is asserted concretely - 'draft and pairing intact after the client process was closed and reopened' - which is the failure mode that most often sends people back to another app.

Delivery state has a real vocabulary and it is legible: 'sent .' (13_messenger_states.png y=430), 'going', 'waiting to send', 'it would not go X' in red (y=2660), and 'read ..' on outgoing notes in 02_chat.png at y=1085 and y=1930.

Ordering in 11_chat_scroll.mp4 is monotonic across all 330 frames - 11:46, 11:58, 14:40, 15:40, 15:50, 16:30 reading down frame 67, and the whole traverse walks cleanly backwards from Wed 22 Apr to Tue 21 Apr with no row repeated or skipped.

Full-text search in 12_search.png highlights every occurrence of the term inside the note ('Rain', 'rain', 'raining') rather than just the row, and offers type filters for written, photographs, video and talking.
coldstart.json shows four events crossing two distinct tailnet nodes (100.68.254.25 / 100.72.198.108, distinct node keys) landing in identical order on both sides.
verdict: The spine underneath this messenger is demonstrably sound - reliability.json's 174 events with zero duplicates, gapless ordering after an induced gap, a 26-event offline queue delivered on reconnect and a kill mid-send that did not double-post is better evidence than most projects produce. What is missing is any proof that the messenger a person touches is equally sound. Every seeded screenshot was captured on a device that 05_settings.png shows as 'not paired yet.' with the link stuck at 'connecting', so the delivery and read markers on screen are seeded decoration and no artifact anywhere shows one changing because a peer acted; the clip that was to show exactly that is absent. The media library, 04_moments.png, is five 'still fetching the picture.' rows and six blank chips with durations on them - not one picture, after a 15.5 s cold start and 2.5 s of settle - which is the rubric's spinner outstaying its welcome in the surface where photos and video live. Typing indication has neither a screenshot nor a line in the sixteen-capability sweep. The dense-scroll clip cannot answer the jank question because it is 330 screenshots taken 1.11 s apart replayed at 60 fps, and it covers about 20 rows of 8,387. 13_messenger_states.png, the artifact meant to carry the whole state vocabulary, is stale from an earlier build, its re-capture crashed in __deskStage() while its log still reports ok: true, and the image that stands in its place has three rows with no surface and an unidentifiable grey slab. Search returns a hit with no visible match in an order the reader cannot explain. Any one of the media library, the missing typing indicator, or the unverifiable read receipts is on its own a reason to open Instagram instead; there are three of them, so the category sits below its floor.
